rejections.note: by_reason is the complete count; rejections.csv holds a deterministic prefix sample per reason so the file stays reviewable

role_audit.rule: for a family whose defining structure is a concavity (star, crescent, heart, forked, band) the measured convexity deficiency (1 - solidity) must agree with the role the plan wrote: a *query* below the no-concavity floor becomes a hard negative, and a *variant* must keep a quarter of the deficiency of the mildest query left in its family. Every demotion is recorded here and on the item, because a convex disk listed as relevant to a crescent query would score the wrong behaviour

revisions.reason: planned as the crescent query but its contour fills 0.9990 of its own convex hull — deficiency 0.0010 against the family's floor 0.01, so it carries none of the concavity that defines crescent and cannot stand as a relevant example of it

planned as a crescent variant but it fills 0.9990 of its own convex hull against the mildest crescent query's 0.7906: deficiency 0.0010 is under the family floor 0.0524, the defining concavity is gone, so as a *relevant* item it would teach the wrong lesson

planned as a crescent variant but it fills 0.9960 of its own convex hull against the mildest crescent query's 0.7906: deficiency 0.0040 is under the family floor 0.0524, the defining concavity is gone, so as a *relevant* item it would teach the wrong lesson

rejected_metrics.sharpest concave turning vertex: a thin crescent's horns meet at a shallow angle spread over many samples, so its peak turn is near zero
rejected_metrics.total inward turning: pen jitter on a drawn circle accumulates to about the same radians as a real crescent's bay

design_coverage.rule: >6 structure classes, >=2 queries, 5-15 variants and 10-20 hard negatives per class, counted from the built gallery after the structural role audit — measured, not restated from the plan

near_duplicate_control.rule: pairs whose E0 align distance is <= the threshold are recorded as near-duplicates and excluded from T2 (and from the relevant set), so no method can score by returning a rigid copy of the query
near_duplicate_control.warning: these pairs are data hygiene for the controlled gallery only; the 839 real landform candidates are untouched and this is not a geographic dedupe rule

matched_envelope_control.rule: an envelope-matched negative is built by bisection on one parameter and the achieved solidity is re-measured from the stored contour; |residual| <= 0.005 counts as matched

settings.T1: exact target present in the library (sanity check on implementation)
settings.T2: target's rigid copies and near-duplicates removed; variants and hard negatives kept (the discriminative setting)
settings.T3: gallery shapes mixed into the real 839-candidate landform index, every candidate labelled with its provenance

reproduce.determinism: synthetic generators are seeded through their parameters; external drawings are chosen even-spaced out of a record list whose byte ranges are pinned to cache/quickdraw/spans.json on the first live build and replayed by every later build, --offline included, so no run can silently scan a different set of drawings. The pinned ranges and each slice's sha256 are recorded under assets and quickdraw_census; the byte-identical live/offline check is logged in experiments/experiment_log.md
